sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Common fund stash is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A 5x5 grid common fund stash which belongs to Shturman.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Shturman's stash key is needed to open this container.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: In the sawmill area on Woods, on top of a tire next to a wood log pile.
